name: Spotify Audio, Lyric-Derived, and Artist Features for Billboard Hit Prediction
description: This dataset contains song metadata, Spotify audio characteristics, lyric-derived features, artist performance information, and binary hit labels used to develop artificial intelligence models for predicting whether a song will become a Billboard Top 100 hit. The public dataset excludes full lyric text and contains only metadata and derived lyrical measurements. The associated research evaluates Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Neural Network, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers.
